pattern: join on two keys and derive one measure from each table
question: put 2023 ANC coverage and employment percentages together, matching district and year
gold_sql: SELECT a.district, ROUND(100.0 * a.anc4_completed / a.pregnancies_registered, 1) AS anc_percent, ROUND(100.0 * l.employed_at_6_months / l.women_enrolled, 1) AS employment_percent FROM anc_visits AS a INNER JOIN livelihoods AS l ON a.district = l.district AND a.year = l.year WHERE a.year = 2023 ORDER BY a.district
sql_duckdb: WITH anc_2023 AS (SELECT district, (anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0)) AS anc_coverage_pct FROM anc_visits WHERE year = 2023), livelihood_2023 AS (SELECT district, (employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0), 0)) AS employment_pct FROM livelihoods WHERE year = 2023) SELECT a.district, a.anc_coverage_pct, l.employment_pct FROM anc_2023 AS a JOIN livelihood_2023 AS l ON a.district = l.district

put 2023 ANC coverage and employment percentages together, matching district and year
attempts.response:
WITH anc_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    (anc4_completed * 100.0 / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0)) AS anc_coverage_pct
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE year = 2023
),
livelihood_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    (employed_at_6_months * 100.0 / NULLIF(women_enrolled, 0)) AS employment_pct
  FROM livelihoods
  WHERE year = 2023
)
SELECT
  a.district,
  a.anc_coverage_pct,
  l.employment_pct
FROM anc_2023 a
JOIN livelihood_2023 l ON a.district = l.district;
